reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and no redline or comment was proposed — consistent with the expectation that compliant findings are recorded as evidence rather than raised as negotiation issues.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Section 3.19 (with the 'Exclusive Period' and 'Competing Product' definitions) binds SFJ, the counterparty, from running trials of or selling competing ticagrelor-reversal agents; restrictions on the vendor are expressly acceptable under the detection guidance and operate in our favour.

No provision cited or otherwise identified restricts PB from developing, acquiring or commercialising competing or alternative products, and there is no post-term non-compete on our side, so the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) is met.

The rationale correctly distinguishes Section 7.5.5 as a financing/collateral consent right over out-licensing of the funded Product rather than a field-of-use or non-compete covenant on our business, and flags it transparently instead of double-counting it under this rule.
The deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes, and the rendered paragraphs are unmodified, as expected for a compliant finding.
